item.text:
Implemented Requirement 016 and committed as `9a4a658da673f9e91b0950409c77a1ae86e116e6`.

The app now supports persistent task deletion and restoration, a Deleted filter, live-task-only project summaries, and read-only deleted task rows. Existing tasks upgrade as live.

Verification passed: JavaScript syntax checks, `/health` returned `{"status":"ok"}`, and an API check confirmed deletion, restoration, and summary counts. The working tree is clean.

Run with `npm start`.
